description: Start a new Fun Friday game session and get back the room code and join link to share with the team. This opens a real room that people can join immediately — confirm with the user before calling it. Works without an account: the room is then limited to the free games, and whoever opens the join link first becomes the host and presses Start, so tell the user to open it themselves before sharing it. With a connected account the room runs on the team's plan, uses one of its games for the week, and its results go on the team leaderboard.

game_type.description: Which game to host. Call funfriday_list_games first if unsure; this is the internal key, not the display name (Imposter is "faker", Colour Clue is "hues_cues").

name: funfriday_create_session

hosted_as.description: "account" when the room was opened on the signed-in user's team; "guest" when it was opened without an account, so the first person to join becomes the host.

title: Start a Fun Friday game
